title: Grilled Thai-Style Chicken Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy Indian-inspired dish, perfect for summer. Marinated chicken is grilled to perfection on skewers.
instructions: 1. In a blender or food processor, combine apricot jam, peanut butter, and curry paste. Blend until smooth.
2. Add the marinade to a large bowl and whisk until combined.
3. Add the chicken to the marinade and mix until coated.
4. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
6. Thread the marinated chicken onto the skewers.
7. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
8. Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
9. Serve hot and garnish with cilantro or scallions if desired.
